This repository contains a historical record of Foulab's bylaws and standing rules, as adopted by the membership.

These documents are written with [Typst](https://typst.app/docs) so they can be easily rendered to formats like PDF or HTML.

To generate the rendered PDF and HTML documents, install `make` and [Typst](https://github.com/typst/typst) and run:

```sh
# all formats
make all
# PDF only
make pdf
# HTML only
make html
# remove generated files
make clean
```
